verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents built-in AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. Users can assign cases to an agent, which auto-remediates level 1 alerts, escalates high-risk cases to humans, and lets the team review or override its decisions. That is real in-product delegation, but it is limited to alert and case triage and supported only by brief marketing statements. Missing for 10: a general-purpose or conversational assistant for arbitrary tasks, detailed first-party docs on how agents are configured and delegated to, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
